title: RUNBUGRUN AN EXECUTABLE DATASET FOR AUTOMATED PROGRAM REPAIR

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Automated Program Repair (APR) and Neural Program Repair (NPR) baselines across eight different programming languages to measure performance disparities and testing cross-language knowledge transfer to counter the existing Java-centricity in the field.

Providing a large-scale, strictly split (train/validation/test) executable dataset and analyzing model repair performance across different problem dimensions to ensure models generalize rather than over-optimizing for specific, small-scale legacy benchmarks.
